dispositions.evidence: work-orders/WB8227-implicit-normal.md:112-116; calculus-design.json:430-440 alternative_criterion_mapping and conditions; exemplars/WB8227-implicit-normal.md:133. Own proofs for the normal exemplar 3e^{2x}y+y^2=4. Divided route: 3e^{2x}+y=4/y; 6e^{2x}+y'=-4y'/y^2; y'=-6e^{2x}y^2/(y^2+4); substituting 4=3e^{2x}y+y^2 gives -6e^{2x}y/(3e^{2x}+2y). Log route: ln3+2x=ln|4-y^2|-ln|y|; 2=-2yy'/(4-y^2)-y'/y; y'=-2y(4-y^2)/(y^2+4), then the same back-substitution gives the target. Both complete proofs mark S1+S2+S3+S4 = 4/4 with the four-mark cap, S4 depending on S1-S3, and no F.T. into the target. sympy confirms both routes reach the target identically for all 27 tuples, and the product and explicit-root routes too. C≠0 makes y≠0 on every curve, and C-y^2=ae^{kx}y≠0.
